reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents an educational review of a purported free Litecoin-mining platform without promoting it or guaranteeing profits. The displayed payment and withdrawal features are accompanied by repeated warnings not to invest or deposit, and the video cautions that payment may not occur. The Telegram giveaway request and subscription prompt are described as audience or platform actions rather than evidence of endorsement or deception.

citations.quote: This video is strictly for educational and review purposes. I am not promoting, partnering, or guaranteeing profits.
This platform offers automatic cloud mining, daily rewards, and instant Litecoin withdrawal

opening.argument: Judge the invitation and the promised payoff together. Viewers are told the site offers daily rewards and instant Litecoin withdrawal, then are offered a registration guide and a path to claim and withdraw. Two website links give them a way to act on that pitch. The no-deposit framing lowers the perceived barrier, but it does not change the central sequence: visit the site, register, and pursue LTC. That is a solicitation for a purportedly easy digital-asset reward, even without a guaranteed payout.

citations.quote: This platform offers automatic cloud mining, daily rewards, and instant Litecoin withdrawal
Step-by-step registration guide
How to claim and withdraw Litecoin
Website Link 1:
without any deposit or investment

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling this an educational review does not answer why the description supplies website links alongside registration and claiming instructions. The payment display establishes only what the site shows, not that a viewer will be paid. Nor does a warning erase the actionable invitation: the video still walks viewers toward a withdrawal request. The defense treats those steps as neutral context, but they are also the steps a viewer would follow to pursue the advertised LTC.

citations.quote: Step-by-step registration guide

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The invitation is presented inside a review that expressly disclaims promotion and guaranteed profits. More importantly, the video warns viewers that payment may not occur and tells them not to invest or deposit. Showing how a third-party site works, including its withdrawal interface, does not establish that the creator endorses its payout claims or intends to deceive viewers.

citations.quote: This video is strictly for educational and review purposes. I am not promoting, partnering, or guaranteeing profits.

opening.argument: The concern is the combination of signals, not any single word. The title advertises free LTC; the description adds daily rewards and instant withdrawal; the site display presents a balance, bonuses, and a withdrawal route. Yet the same video warns that payment may never arrive. A careful judge should not treat a displayed balance or payment table as proof of a real payout. When an uncertain outcome is packaged with easy-reward language and a usable claim flow, the warnings do not remove the risk that viewers will pursue an unverified reward.

citations.quote: New Litecoin Mining Site – 100% Free LTC!
This platform offers automatic cloud mining, daily rewards, and instant Litecoin withdrawal

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense points to warnings and the displayed withdrawal features. But those features show an interface, not a completed withdrawal to the viewer; the video itself cautions that payment may not occur. The warning strengthens the need to scrutinize the reward claims. A disclaimer about profits does not substantiate the separate claims of daily rewards and instant withdrawal.

citations.quote: daily rewards, and instant Litecoin withdrawal

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Unverified payouts are precisely why the video cautions viewers. It says earnings are not guaranteed, warns that they may not receive payment, and explicitly advises against investing or depositing. The prosecution identifies reasons to distrust the third-party site, but those signals do not establish that this warning-oriented review is itself a deceptive offer.

opening.argument: Assess what the review enables, not only what it calls itself. The description promises a registration guide, a live dashboard demonstration, and instructions for claiming and withdrawing Litecoin. It also provides website links. That turns the video into a practical route from curiosity to participation. The additional instruction to join a Telegram channel for giveaways reinforces the use of rewards to move viewers into an external channel. Educational language and warnings may temper the pitch, but the concrete actions offered still steer viewers toward purportedly free assets.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense separates the giveaway and subscription prompt from the site demonstration, but the description places the giveaway join request alongside the review's website links. It also advertises registration and withdrawal guidance. Those are participation paths, not just observations. The stated educational purpose is relevant, but it cannot by itself settle how an actionable reward-focused video functions for its audience.

Step-by-step registration guide
How to claim and withdraw Litecoin

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Practical instruction is compatible with examining a site. The creator expressly says this is a review, disclaims promotion and guaranteed profits, and includes warnings against deposits and about nonpayment. The Telegram giveaway request is an audience action, but the cited material does not link joining it to a Litecoin payout or show that the creator has verified or endorsed the mining site's claims.
